head: 8 new lifestyle apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These lifestyle apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Lifestyle charts this week, from BabyBackup: Baby Monitor to One Cent Start.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store charts this week
means: If you're looking for something new in lifestyle, these are small apps people are buying right now.
todo: Open each app's App Store page to check the price, in-app purchases and what it needs before you download.

list.name: BabyBackup: Baby Monitor
list.what: Turns two devices you already own into a baby monitor, with no internet needed.

list.name: Tots Weather
list.what: Tells you what your child should wear for today's weather.

list.name: Post Club: A Little Typewriter
list.what: A little typewriter for writing notes and letters with clicking keys.

list.name: Gardener's Pocket Book
list.what: Builds a month-by-month planting calendar from your ZIP code.

list.name: MyPlantMap
list.what: Maps and tracks your garden plants on satellite images of your property.

list.name: Leash Lookout
list.what: Turns your daily dog walk into a map of the houses and people on the way.

list.name: Nāda Brahma: Saṃyama Sessions
list.what: Sound meditation with recordings of real gongs, singing bowls and chimes.

list.name: One Cent Start
list.what: One short reflection and meditation for every morning of the year.
